text:
Hana C: heads-up — bringing up comet-32k (int8 hybrid) and seeing repeated token alignment deltas right after 31k when we stream with prefix-caching on. curious if this is RoPE phase or cache tile reassembly.
Ben R: concise repro?
Hana C: using the standard legal-append test. cmd:
```
./onboard_longctx --model comet-32k --quant int8-hybrid --ropescale rescale2 --stream-prefix-cache true --prefill_stride 64 --job comet-20260405-01
```
Hana C: log snippet where things shift:
```
[2026-04-05T14:21:03Z] KV-DUMP: tile=30 start=30720 len=1024 checksum=0x9f2b4a
[2026-04-05T14:21:03Z] KV-DEQ: tile=30 checksum=0x9f2b4a
[2026-04-05T14:21:03Z] INFER(INT8): token=30745 -> "clause" prob=0.66
[2026-04-05T14:21:03Z] INFER(FP16): token=30745 -> "clause." prob=0.92
[2026-04-05T14:21:03Z] DIFF: downstream shift +1 at global=30745
```
Mia Nguyen: streaming + prefix caching + hybrid quant sounds like a stress point. did you try disabling stream cache?
Hana C: yes — turning stream-prefix-cache off removes the repro entirely. with it on we see ~40% repro rate.
Kai L: can you try `--rotary-interpolate true` and `--quant-scale-mode global`? those fixed similar cases for other models.
Hana C: queued run comet-20260405-02 with those flags.
ci-bot: job comet-20260405-01 artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-ci/comet-20260405-01/logs.tar.gz
Ben R: if disabling cache eliminates it, might be a cache reassembly ordering bug during shard stream joins. but also could be tiny rotary phase mismatch that only manifests when we stitch cached prefixes.
Hana C: re-run summary: with rotary_interpolate + global-scale, divergence count drops from 8/10 -> 1/10. latency +6% on tail, memory +80MB.
Mia Nguyen: run a hybrid-localization: keep stream-cache on but force dequantization at join time to fp16 (i.e., materialize dequant before stitching). if that kills repro, it's quant join ordering.
Hana C: did that (job comet-20260405-03) — dequant-before-join removed the last flake.
Kai L: strong signal for quantized-join ordering causing tiny rounding that flips punctuation at boundary. recommend adding a fast-path dequant-verify during onboarding for streamed prefixes.
Hana C: logging ML ticket ML-9680 to add dequant-verify and the 31k streaming-caching regression to onboarding checklist. attaching artifacts.
ci-bot: job comet-20260405-02 and comet-20260405-03 completed, artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/comet-20260405-02/ , s3://redwood-ci/comet-20260405-03/
Mia Nguyen: thanks — let's also run pairwise token-level KL and a tiny human read on the 1k windows around 30.5k-31.5k to ensure no subtle quality regressions after dequant-verify.
Ben R: will add short perf budget note: if hosted needs stream-cache, consider dequant-verify as optional but enabled for canary dedicated pools.
Hana C: PR with dequant-verify and tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/857
Kai L: dropping a :thumbsup: — assign me if we need deeper infra traces.
Hana C: thanks all, closing until further flake reproductions.
